# TASK-163 — specification

## Scope

OpenSpec reviewed imports: read-only preview, revision-guarded proposals and separate explicit board merges, role/feature enforcement, audit and documented API contracts.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Preview imports without writes.
- [ ] Specification changes become proposals, with revision and role checks.
- [ ] Board imports require a separate explicit action and expected board revision; retain PR links, dependencies and identities.
- [ ] Do not import approval or baseline claims.
- [ ] Enforce feature gates, audit and OpenAPI.
